questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: State and prove Superposition Theorem, Thevenin's Theorem, Norton's Theorem, and Maximum Power Transfer Theorem for AC circuits containing independent and dependent sources. Determine the load impedance $Z_L$ for maximum power transfer ($Z_L = Z_{th}^*$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Solve a two-port network: Define $Z$-parameters, $Y$-parameters, $ABCD$ (Transmission) parameters, and $h$-parameters. Derive conditions for Reciprocity ($Z_{12} = Z_{21}, AD - BC = 1$) and Symmetry ($Z_{11} = Z_{22}, A = D$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Derive expressions for Resonant Frequency ($f_0 = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}$), Quality Factor ($Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R}$), and Half-Power Bandwidth ($\Delta f = f_0 / Q$) in Series RLC and Parallel RLC circuits. Draw frequency response curves for current and impedance.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Three-Phase Systems and Balanced/Unbalanced Power Measurement
questions.text: Derive Line and Phase relationships in balanced Star and Delta 3-phase connections. Explain the Two-Wattmeter Method for measuring active and reactive power. Show that $\tan\phi = \sqrt{3}\frac{W_1 - W_2}{W_1 + W_2}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Derive the transient current response $i(t)$ when a DC voltage $V$ is switched across a series $R-L$ circuit ($i(t) = \frac{V}{R}(1 - e^{-t/\tau})$) and series $R-C$ circuit ($i(t) = \frac{V}{R}e^{-t/\tau}$). Define Time Constant $\tau$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Formulate the Second-Order differential equation for a series $R-L-C$ circuit subjected to a step voltage. Classify and sketch responses for Overdamped ($R > 2\sqrt{L/C}$), Critically Damped ($R = 2\sqrt{L/C}$), and Underdamped ($R < 2\sqrt{L/C}$) conditions using Laplace Transforms.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Derive the Equivalent Circuit of a Single-Phase Transformer referred to primary and secondary windings. Explain Open-Circuit (OC) test and Short-Circuit (SC) test for finding core loss ($P_i$), copper loss ($P_{cu}$), equivalent resistance $R_{01}$, and reactance $X_{01}$. Derive the condition for Maximum Efficiency (Iron loss = Copper loss).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: AC Circuit Analysis, Resonance and Phasor Representation
questions.text: Explain Voltage Regulation of a transformer at lagging, unity, and leading power factors: $\text{VR} = \frac{I_2(R_{02}\cos\phi_2 \pm X_{02}\sin\phi_2)}{V_2} \times 100\%$. Draw the complete phasor diagram for lagging power factor load.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Three-Phase Induction Motors and Starting Methods
questions.text: Explain the production of a Rotating Magnetic Field in a 3-Phase Induction Motor. Derive the Torque equation: $T = \frac{3}{\omega_s} \frac{V^2 (R_2'/s)}{(R_1 + R_2'/s)^2 + (X_1 + X_2')^2}$. Derive maximum torque ($T_{max} = \frac{3 V^2}{2\omega_s [R_1 + \sqrt{R_1^2 + (X_1 + X_2')^2}]}$) and slip at maximum torque ($s_{max} = \frac{R_2'}{\sqrt{R_1^2 + (X_1 + X_2')^2}}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Synchronous Generators and Synchronous Motors
questions.text: Explain working of a 3-Phase Synchronous Generator (Alternator). Derive the EMF equation: $E_{ph} = 4.44 k_p k_d f \Phi T_{ph}$. Explain Synchronous Impedance Method (EMF Method) for determining voltage regulation.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Three-Phase Induction Motors and Starting Methods
questions.text: Explain Double Revolving Field Theory for Single-Phase Induction Motors. Explain starting methods: Split-Phase, Capacitor-Start, Capacitor-Start Capacitor-Run, and Shaded-Pole motors.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Three-Phase Induction Motors and Starting Methods
questions.text: Explain Synchronous Motor starting methods (Damper windings, pony motor). Draw $V$-Curves and Inverted $V$-Curves showing variation of armature current and power factor with field excitation. Explain Synchronous Condenser.
